svg.title: A function and its inverse
svg.desc: The crimson curve y = f(x), where f(x) = 0.5x cubed + 0.5x + 2, rises from lower left to upper right and passes through (1, 3). The blue curve y = f inverse of x is its mirror image across the dashed line y = x and passes through (3, 1). Short black lines touch the curves at those points: slope 2 on f at (1, 3) and slope 1/2 on the inverse at (3, 1). Swapping x and y flips slopes to their reciprocals.
